question: Question linked to the image nº15 Patient of 25 years of age transferred to the Rescue Box of the Emergency Service after traffic accident. At admission, he is hypotensive, tachycardic and tachypneic. Portable chest radiography shows right costal fractures from the fourth costal arch to the ninth and right pulmonary contusion image, and the pelvis is attached. What is the best behavior next?

options.opa: Perform abdominal ultrasound in the emergency box.
options.opd: Request computed tomography of the abdomen and pelvis.
options.ope: Immediately enter the patient in the intensive care unit.
